integrity: The model definitions, finite rational checks, and analytic trace-class proof are given with a standalone checker. Finite computations do not certify the spectral asymptotic. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal-rate irreversible dimer adsorption only; the theorem concerns eventual hub vacancy, not complete jamming statistics. The exponential constant is an implicit modified-Bessel root. Historical priority remains provisional against older inaccessible full manuscripts.
title: Exact hub-avoidance decay for dimer adsorption on wheel networks
